title: A Critical Case for the Near Field Refraction Problem in Negative Refractive Index Material
summary: This paper studies the near field refraction problem for the critical case in negative refractive index material. Snell law in vector form is first reviewed, and the physical constraint governing refraction is discussed. We then define the refractor for the critical case and analyze several of its key properties. Building on these properties, we introduce the notion of a weak solution to this problem and prove the existence of the weak solution when the target measure is either discrete or a finite Radon measure.
